meta.name: Create LinkedIn posts and Twitter threads from Telegram with Groq AI

parameters.content:
## Route and transcribe input

Determines whether the Telegram input is audio or text. Voice messages are downloaded, prepared with code, and transcribed through Groq Whisper, while text messages continue directly toward post generation.

## Generate LinkedIn content

Sends the text or transcription to Groq Llama to draft a LinkedIn post, then parses the model response into a format suitable for publishing.

## Publish and confirm

Publishes the generated content to LinkedIn and then sends the ready post or confirmation back to Telegram.

## Untitled workflow

### How it works

This workflow turns Telegram messages into LinkedIn posts. It receives a Telegram update, responds to /start, routes text or voice input, transcribes voice messages with Groq Whisper, generates a post with Groq Llama, publishes it to LinkedIn, and sends the result back through Telegram.

### Setup steps

- Configure Telegram bot credentials for the trigger and Telegram action nodes, including the bot token and any required chat settings.
- Add Groq API authentication to the HTTP Request nodes for both Whisper transcription and Llama chat completion requests.
- Configure LinkedIn credentials and set the correct posting target, such as a personal profile or organization page.
- Review the JavaScript parsing/preparation nodes to ensure they match the Telegram payload format and the expected Groq response structure.

### Customization

Adjust the Groq Llama prompt to control tone, length, hashtags, and formatting of the LinkedIn post. You can also modify the /start welcome text, supported Telegram input types, or whether the workflow publishes immediately versus sending a draft for approval.

## Telegram entry handling

Receives incoming Telegram messages, checks whether the user sent /start, and sends a welcome message for that command before continuing normal messages into the workflow.

parameters.text:
=👋 **Welcome to your AI Content Assistant!**

I turn your quick voice notes or rough text rants into high-converting posts for **LinkedIn** and **Twitter**.

---

### 💡 How to Use This Bot:

🎙️ **Option 1: Voice Note**
• Press the mic icon and record a 15–60 second voice rant sharing a thought, lesson, or opinion.
• I'll transcribe it using **Whisper AI** and write your posts automatically.

📝 **Option 2: Text Message**
• Type or paste any raw idea, bullet points, or draft text directly into the chat.

---

### 📋 What You Get Back:
1. 📘 **A formatted LinkedIn Post** (Auto-published to your feed!).
2. 🧵 **A Twitter Thread** (each tweet in its own box so you can **tap-to-copy** instantly).

Give it a shot! Send a voice message or type an idea below 👇
